info.title: DocIntel Public API
info.description: Aggregated public surface of the DocIntel platform, as exposed through the api-gateway. Generated from each service's OpenAPI export by scripts/generate-openapi.py — do not hand-edit; regenerate instead.

delete.description:
Flush the entire ModelProfileResolver cache (platform profiles changed).
Called by the UI after platform-scope model profile CRUD.

get.description:
Paginated feedback items for the Feedback Review page — query + answer
(+ any sources captured at feedback time) with an ANY LEFT JOIN back to
query_events for the Langfuse trace_id (B4 deep-link). Defaults to no
liked filter; the UI defaults its own view to dislikes-only for triage.
Aggregate like/dislike counts. Tenant scoped via X-Tenant-Id header.
Time-series of likes/dislikes bucketed by day.

Abstention rate (queries with 0 sources — the RAG pipeline's no-docs
branch), reranker-degraded count, feedback score distribution, plus a
daily breakdown for the Insights quality-over-time chart.
Query count and avg latency grouped by model_used.
Aggregate query stats: avg latency, cache hit rate, query count.
Time-series of query count + avg latency bucketed by hour or day.
Most frequent queries and zero-result queries (corpus-gap detector).
Query volume, unique users, p50/p95 latency, cache-hit ratio for the window.
Return the list of available sample datasets. Consumed by the web-UI Documents page.

post.description:
Start bulk-loading sample datasets; returns 202 + job_id immediately.

Subscribe to GET /datasets/load/{job_id}/progress for SSE progress updates.
Isolation: job is scoped to the requesting tenant (JWT-derived X-Tenant-Id).

get.description:
SSE stream for dataset load job progress.

Isolation: job_id is UUID4 (unguessable) AND we validate X-Tenant-Id so
cross-tenant reads are impossible.

post.description:
Accept a document ingestion job via REST (test/debug path only).

Production traffic flows exclusively through the [documents.ready] Redis stream.
Disabled by default (INGESTION_REST_ENABLED=false). Enable only for integration tests.

get.description:
List all models available from the configured LLM engine, with capability
flags so the UI can filter per-kind dropdowns (chat / vlm / rerank).

Embed models are returned for completeness but the UI typically hides them
because the embed model is env-locked.

post.description:
RAG query with tenant isolation and RBAC.
Gateway claims always take precedence — clients cannot override tenant_id.
Thin streaming handler — delegates all orchestration to RAGService.stream().

delete.description:
Flush ModelProfileResolver cache entries for a specific tenant.
Called by the UI after tenant-scope model profile CRUD.

get.description:
Return fully-resolved effective sampling parameters for a (tenant, model) pair.
Resolution chain: tenant DB → platform DB → built-in defaults → env var fallbacks.
All values are guaranteed non-null (env fallbacks applied).

delete.description:
Invalidate the in-process TenantModelResolver cache for all users in a tenant.
Called by the UI after tenant model settings change.

Invalidate the in-process TenantModelResolver cache for a specific user.
Called by the UI immediately after user preferences are saved.

DocumentACL.title: DocumentACL
DocumentACL.description:
Access-control metadata stored on every ingested document chunk.

Defaults represent the baseline posture for internal documents:
all authenticated tenant members may read, no department/region restriction.

Error.description: Standard DocIntel error envelope (G7.3), returned by every service and by the gateway itself (401/403/429/503) for any non-2xx response.
